title: Bit construction: 55 same-frame rewrites on composed R439 save 110 ADDs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Finite bit-circuit construction; no new kappa or supplier adoption.** On the frozen complete PR1122 A/B/star-D word, 55 same-frame commuting Steinberg rewrites reduce **10,652 → 10,542 ADDs**, including literal cleanup. Every physical MOVE path, COPY/ERASE record and actual paid rank histogram remains unchanged (rank mass 5129).

Positive prefixes improve from F=15223 / B=3910388 to **F=13721 / B=3663878**. Exact local/nine-stage envelopes require **91/174 bits**, below strict inherited 104/192 caps. All source access, helpers, restoration, copies, bridges and recursive ranks remain charged.

The inherited syntactic H2 and K_equals_D flags remain false; all other owning H/K checks pass. Finite endpoints and precision do not establish selected hosted-supplier adoption or the complete multiplication theorem. PR1194's pending semantic-D proof is acknowledged but not adopted.

## Task and overlap

No pinned coordination issue existed; the discussion board was read.

- [PR1127](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1127): 2e9dc9d3356a6b7258ed869ddcee46352907f746, commuting-triangle method on the different PR589 word.

Final overlap refresh covered new PRs through #1205. Concurrent [PR1188](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1188), head 6e142e72e94515566e87c964c0fca39eea93156f, has the smaller **10,492-ADD** sibling via five-wire shortest programs. **This is not an ADD-count record.** Our independently checked alternative has a smaller backward bound and exact local/nine envelopes: nine-stage upper **22973795977533615901914742933524089773622692690264064 (174 bits)** versus its **24941709210337926871896158204497246778939630375927808 (175 bits)**. Its frozen word and original notice are retained solely for independent literal endpoint/invoice comparison; its GL5 optimum is not replayed or claimed here. Sibling savings are not assumed additive. PR1181's provenance/credit receipt is also acknowledged.

## Validation

~~~sh
BOOST_INCLUDE=/path/to/boost python3 -I -B research/r439-abc-zrewrite-seed16/native.py
~~~

Expected: PASS_R439_ABC_ZREWRITE_NATIVE: 2 words; 5/9/11 stages; 96 bridge controls; rank_mass5129; no_new_kappa.

- Independent occurrence-aware witness reconstruction imports no discovery code; all five phase maps and 661 arbitrary dirty input columns pass in both full orientations.
- Normal and optimized quick certificate replay pass; **11 negative controls** reject, including noncommuting insertion, wrong duplicate occurrence, COPY/ERASE omissions, nonliteral cleanup and strict equality at precision caps.
- Fresh unchanged native legality and 5/9/11-stage checks cover **883/1327/1549 columns**, exact complete scalar/bridge/copy invoices, all ordered frame paths and **96 omitted-bridge controls**.
- Discovery reaches its bounded fixed point in three rounds (54 A moves, one B); regeneration is byte identical. Final census: 417 occurrences, 79 cross-section and 338 noncommuting. This is not a global optimum or impossibility result.
- All 17 retained repository dependency pins match; exact source AST binds the precision formulas. Selected PR1094 certificate guard and staged whitespace check pass.

Tested on macOS, Python3.9.6, Apple clang21, Boost1.87.0. Only this new research directory is added. Selected frontier, upstream/ and frozen predecessors are untouched. No repository-wide historical suite, selected hosted cold replay, Linux replay, hosted CI success or independent human review is claimed. See VALIDATION.md for complete receipts and unrun obligations.
